node.title: Re: Not finding NDBM_File.pm
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
..oracle/product/12.2.0.1/perl/lib/5.22.0/Memoize>ls -ltr NDBM_File.pm -rwxr-xr-x 1 oracle dba 1488 May 12 2016 NDBM_File.pm

What you've found there is [doc://Memoize::NDBM_File], not [doc://NDBM_File]. You need to check directly in the directories listed for [doc://@INC] in that error message, not any of their subdirectories. Do you have that file there?

By the way, please use tags to format input/output/code.
